sources.title: AutoPipeline - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Detects a "stable-diffusion"class from the model_index.jsonfile. Depending on the task you're interested in, it loads the StableDiffusionPipeline, StableDiffusionImg2ImgPipeline, or StableDiffusionInpaintPipeline. Any parameter (strength, num_inference_steps, etc.) you would pass to these specific pipelines can also be passed to the AutoPipeline.
